sloka: जनानाम् रतिसम्योगेष्वत्यन्तगुणवन्ति च ।तान्येतान्यद्य वश्यामि निरानन्दानि सर्वशः ॥२-७१-२६॥
transliteration: janānām ratisamyogeṣvatyantaguṇavanti ca ।tānyetānyadya vaśyāmi nirānandāni sarvaśaḥ ॥2-71-26॥

translations.english: ﻿﻿ Now the trees appear cheerless, the paths are full of dry leaves fallen all over. It appears as if the trees are crying.
